prompt_en: Create a cinematic photorealistic night photograph of an unmistakably adult young East Asian woman portrayed as an elegant witch, with the same delicate oval face, pale beige-blonde hair with airy fringe, gray-brown eyes, and soft rose makeup as the attached portrait. She flies side-on across a clear night sky on a wooden broom; her complete seated figure and the entire broom overlap the center of an enormous luminous full moon. Her black pointed hat, midnight-blue dress, cape, hair, and ribbons stream backward. One hand grips the broom while the other steadies her hat; she wears a calm, delighted smile. Use a vertical 4:5 telephoto frame containing the lunar disc, with the figure rising diagonally. Let the moon create bright circular backlight and crisp silver rim light, balanced by cool frontal fill that keeps her face and broom bristles readable. Retain realistic adult eye scale, face length, jaw width, and natural asymmetry. Add faint clouds and sleeping-town lights far below, natural fabric motion, atmospheric haze, fine film grain, and a fantasy-editorial photographic finish.
